title: susi peers status shows a live but unreachable member as live, not offline
goal: Follow-up to T-HOMECLUSTER-1 (core 923501f8b): a key-bound member that discovery still sees but whose status call fails now carries live_via_discovery. The status table printed every error row as 'offline'; it now prints 'live, status unavailable (<error>)' for those rows and keeps 'offline' for members discovery does not see. The row formatting moved into status_line with unit tests for both cases and for a reachable member.
